test-statistic.def: A standardized measure of how far a sample statistic is from the null value: $\frac{\text{statistic} - \text{parameter}}{\text{standard error of the statistic}}$. For one proportion, $z = \frac{\hat{p} - p_0}{\sqrt{p_0(1 - p_0)/n}}$.

p-value.def: The probability, assuming the null hypothesis is true, of getting a statistic at least as extreme as the one observed, in the direction of the alternative. It is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true.
